notes.content:

The latest patch for Gundam Breaker 4 is ready to deploy! This update aims to improve gameplay and fix some outstanding bugs.

・Adjusting the Long-Range Weapon and Long-Range Skill

notes.title: 【Details of the new update patch】
notes.content:
This update includes new Mobile Suits, improvements to gameplay stability and fixes for some of the known issues. Please update to the latest patch for the best experience! 

[h3]◆Details of update[/h3]
・Added a configuration option to turn on/off the warning display when selling or combining parts saved in the high rarity/inherent or single unit/label/blueprint categories
・Added a sort filter for individual abilities on the assembly screen
・Added “Order of Creation” to the sort options on the assembly screen 
・Added a shortcut button for labels on the assembly screen
・With the exception of some skills, a setting has been added to the configuration that allows you to activate Builder's Parts skills while maintaining their position and size, etc. 
・A shortcut to the shop has been added to the menu in the lobby 
・With the exception of some parts, the emissive color has been reflected in the GN particle effects 
・The lock-on function would not focus on the destructed part without a break point in the boss battle
・ Improved the camera mouse control in the lobby and during missions on the Steam.

Online play requires the player to apply this update.

Further updates will be distributed in the future for you to continue to enjoy Gundam Breaker 4 more comfortably. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: GUNDAM BREAKER 4 Coming in 2024!
notes.content:
[h2]Watch the Extended Announcement Trailer![/h2]

[previewyoutube=kiEwPKg9Aco;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1672500/4/

[b]Gundam Breaker[/b] is a series of action games in which players make their very own Gunpla (Gundam plastic model), by freely combining various parts, such as a Gundam head on a Zaku body, and control it in battle!

[b]Gundam Breaker[/b] is the only series focusing on deep Gunpla customization, where creativity is your power! Use your creativity to win exciting battles against a variety of other Gunpla, such as 1/60 Perfect Grade and 1/144 size models.

This latest title in the Gundam Breaker series is now bigger and better than ever!

[h3][i]▼Make your very own Gunpla[/i][/h3]

Put together your very own Gunpla by freely combining 11 different parts, including head, torso, right arm, left arm, legs, and backpack, and prepare for battle! Individual parts can be painted or even weathered to look dirtied or damaged to match your unique style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899826/eb8693b1ff41672ee6644b7e9e60c1105504f288.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899826/63624b15bc84acf661ef43fdabcdc02c1599d6be.jpg[/img]

[h3][i]▼Powered-up dual-wielding action[/i][/h3]

Take on a range of challenging missions using your very own Gunpla, which can wield different weapons in its right and left hands! Smart use of weapons & their abilities to create exciting combos will be the key to success.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899826/45e357fca1cc3ba271235f19c11efe593da66303.jpg[/img]

[h3][i]▼Break enemies to harvest parts from their models.[/i][/h3]

Acquired parts come with Abilities that help you make your Gunpla uniquely yours - the more missions you undertake, the closer you can come to refining your dream Gunpla!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899826/a66c9bd8713c0cefd8ea2c3a1997f97a882beeb7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899826/aa402ed629e784b275c874d8e2a8a08ca2fdec70.jpg[/img]

[h3][i]▼Build and show your Diorama[/i][/h3]

The introduction of Diorama Mode in this title allows players to create their very own diorama, complete with Gunpla, background, and special effects!

Create your own diorama, take that perfect photo, and show it off to other players in the online gallery!
